# Coagulation Test Result

> A UK NHS–aligned **coagulation / haemostasis test result (report)** that a reporting clinician completes after a coagulation test has been performed. It is the **result/report counterpart** to *Coagulation Test Request* (a referral): where the request captures why the tests should be done and is it safe, this form records the reported **result values** and a structured **interpretation**. It records the performed analysis and specimen condition, the clinical history and anticoagulant status, the coagulation result values (prothrombin time / INR, activated partial thromboplastin time / ratio, fibrinogen, D-dimer, thrombin time, and factor assays), the narrative and impression, and recommended follow-up — then computes a **four-axis interpretation grade** (result classification, abnormality severity / structured reporting, report completeness, and follow-up urgency) plus a set of safety-critical flags including an automatic **critical-result alert**. The output is a structured haematology report.
